claims: Good Friday services occur on April 3, 2026.
Good Friday services are Christian gatherings reflecting on the crucifixion and death of Jesus Christ.
Good Friday services are often held at 3 p.m. to mark the tradition of his death hour.
In Catholic traditions, Communion uses elements consecrated on Holy Thursday.
The Passion Narrative is read during Good Friday services.
The Passion Narrative is often from John.
Veneration of the Cross occurs during Good Friday services.
Worshippers show reverence to the cross during Veneration of the Cross.
Solemn Intercessions occur during Good Friday services.
Solemn Intercessions are extensive prayers for the church, the world, and all humanity.
Catholic Good Friday services have no Eucharist.
Some Protestant Good Friday services have no Eucharist.
Catholic Good Friday services are a distinct service without the full Mass.
In some traditions, communion is offered from elements kept from the night before.
Some churches hold a Tenebrae service on Good Friday.
Tenebrae service is a Service of Darkness.
Tenebrae service involves the gradual extinguishing of candles.
Some churches hold an outdoor Crosswalk on Good Friday.
The outdoor Crosswalk involves carrying a cross.
Most Catholic, Episcopal, Lutheran, and Evangelical churches hold Good Friday services.
Good Friday services are often held in the early afternoon or evening.
Many congregations offer virtual Good Friday services.
Many congregations offer live streaming Good Friday services.
The Basilica of the National Shrine offers Good Friday services on YouTube.
Lakewood Church offers Good Friday services.
Good Friday services are part of Holy Week.
Good Friday services transition from Maundy Thursday into Easter Sunday.
